Releases local resources. For a launched browser this terminates the process serving its CDP endpoint and awaits its exit — on POSIX that terminate reaches the launch's whole process group and awaits its drain, and on Windows it terminates one process by identifier, the spawned process or the one a launcher handed the endpoint to — which leaves the profile unlocked before cleanup. For an adopted attachment it sends CDP `Browser.close`. For a merely attached browser this is a LOCAL DETACH ONLY because other clients may share its targets. Idempotent.
